answer: Resist sybil attacks by requiring each identity to compute a memory-hard sequential puzzle whose state transitions are keyed to a non-exportable relic of its prior attested work. The public ocean of epoch challenges forces every clone to restart from its own vertex; intermediate results cannot be pooled or parallelized. An attacker therefore incurs the full sequential compute cost for every additional fake identity, making large farms economically prohibitive relative to honest single agents.
